You are an agent that can interact with a computer through bash tool calls.

Every assistant response must include at least one bash tool call. Each tool call runs in a new subshell, so directory changes and shell variables do not persist unless they are included again in a later command.

To finish the task, execute `echo COMPLETE_TASK_AND_SUBMIT_FINAL_OUTPUT` as the only command in a bash tool call. After that command, no further work can be performed.

Set up the benchmark Git project at git@localhost:/git/project with password authentication using the specified password, and deploy main and dev pushes within three seconds to their separate Nginx HTTPS paths on port 8443. Exercise the first branch publication through password SSH. Then install a deployment SSH key, publish a follow-up dev commit through that key, and verify both web paths. Bring up HTTPS first with a stage self-signed certificate, then perform a zero-downtime rotation to a release self-signed certificate by using a client trust bundle containing both certificates during the transition. Write /app/deployment-report.json with branch contents, SSH authentication settings, account status, active server certificate fingerprint, client trust fingerprints, certificate validity, key-file metadata, and the post-receive hook path. Do not print private keys or password hashes.
I will initialize the Git account, repository, branch deployment hook, and SSH listener.

function.arguments:
{"command": "set -e; useradd -m -s /bin/bash git; printf 'git:password\n' | chpasswd; install -d -m 755 /git /var/www/main /var/www/dev /run/sshd; git init --bare /git/project; chown -R git:git /git/project; cat > /git/project/hooks/post-receive <<'SH'
#!/bin/sh
while read old new ref; do
 case $ref in
  refs/heads/main) target=/var/www/main;;
  refs/heads/dev) target=/var/www/dev;;
  *) continue;;
 esac
 find $target -mindepth 1 -delete
 git --git-dir=/git/project archive $new | tar -x -C $target
done
SH
chmod 755 /git/project/hooks/post-receive; cat > /etc/ssh/sshd_config.release <<'EOF'
Port 2222
ListenAddress 127.0.0.1
HostKey /etc/ssh/ssh_host_ed25519_key
PasswordAuthentication yes
PubkeyAuthentication yes
PermitRootLogin no
UsePAM no
AuthorizedKeysFile .ssh/authorized_keys
PidFile /run/sshd-release.pid
Subsystem sftp internal-sftp
EOF
/usr/sbin/sshd -f /etc/ssh/sshd_config.release; for i in $(seq 1 20); do test -s /run/sshd-release.pid && break; sleep .1; done; test -s /run/sshd-release.pid; /usr/sbin/sshd -T -f /etc/ssh/sshd_config.release | grep -E '^(passwordauthentication|pubkeyauthentication) '"}
